# Tigerhawk Logistics

Tigerhawk Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Tigerhawk Logistics is a tech-enabled 4PL built on Port Houston, providing one-stop logistics solutions through a company-owned drayage, a 325,000 SF Gulf Coast warehouse hub, freight brokerage, and a national partner-warehouse network. Tigerhawk Logistics employs 27 people (+8.0% YoY, +2 people), founded in 2022. Headquartered in Pasadena, Texas, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Brazil.

## About

TIGERHAWK is an upstart in the drayage and container logistics business, based in the Houston, TX area. We are a privately-funded, diverse, tight-knit team making an aggressive entrance into the market, with a roadmap for rapid expansion. We have an all-star team with proven experience across the commodities, services, transportation, and logistics industries. Every member of our team was carefully chosen to add top-notch value to our organization and customers. ​

TIGERHAWK brings heavy-hitting knowledge, deep industry connections, and strong capabilities to provide custom solutions to our clients, while providing personal customer attention. We make solutions, not excuses – and our stance on honesty, communication, and partnership with our clients is clear and non-negotiable. We will get the job done for you, and we will do it promptly and fairly, without cut corners, NO EXCEPTIONS.​

Our initial portfolio of service offerings is based around efficient use of our fleet and warehouse operations to provide customized drayage, transloading and last-mile delivery services.

TIGERHAWK was formed as a coalition of professionals who grew weary of "just good enough" being the best possible outcome for customers in the drayage and container logistics markets. ​

We grew tired of seeing cut corners and questionable business practices by competitors. We promise to not only do better than the status quo, but to be an industry leader in transparency and honesty. Our business ethics are non-negotiable.​

We have made safety and compliance a primary focus from day 1 of our operations. The TIGERHAWK culture is structured around the requirement that everyone goes home safely after a day of honest work. We promise top-tier safety and compliance practices, because it is the right thing to do for our people. ​

results.text:
# Hawk Logistics LLC

Hawk Logistics LLC is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Hawk Logistics delivers freight to America with over 100k loads executed with excellence. Hawk Logistics LLC employs 35 people (+66.7% YoY, +14 people), founded in 2013. Headquartered in Vancouver, Washington, United States.

## About

Hawk Logistics, an asset-based trucking company headquartered in Vancouver, Washington. Since our inception in 2013, we have steadily grown into a dynamic force in the transportation industry. We are proudly owned and managed by truck drivers. This insider perspective allows us to truly understand the needs of the industry and our drivers; ensuring a supportive and collaborative environment that promotes success.

At Hawk Logistics, our mission is clear: to Empower People and Perfect Logistics. We are committed to providing exceptional service to our customers while fostering a culture that values and invests in our team. With a focus on continuous improvement and innovation, we strive to optimize logistics solutions, making transportation more efficient and reliable.

As we continue to grow, our dedication to excellence remains unwavering. Whether you’re a client seeking reliable transportation services or a skilled truck driver looking for a company that understands your needs, Hawk Logistics is here to deliver on our promise of Empowered People and Perfected Logistics.
